The '''mother''' of [[Diblen Harleys]] was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. She died when her son was around the age of fifteen.<ref name="TLC" />
